title: Juggling Sequence
source_topic: ICPC / The 2020 Asia Can Tho Regional Contest
statement: A sequence begins at one, and each later term is formed from the previous one by adding the index when the term does not exceed it and subtracting the index otherwise. Given a length and a rank, each up to a quintillion, the task is to report which value occupies that rank once the first terms are sorted in non-decreasing order, for up to ten thousand queries.
